messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: p99 latency for /v1/streaming > 12s across cont-batch path. Dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/alerts/12345 :fire:
maya: ack, I'm oncall. seeing p99 jump at 09:12 UTC. routing and cont-batch metrics spiking.
sam: joining. quick metric check -> p95 ~ 800ms but p99 ~ 12-18s. looks like large-batch tailing. logs show batching window held 1000+ requests into single pack.
luis: confirming. KV miss ratio up from 2% -> 48% on the hot shard; pack amplification on mixed-seq feed.
maya: immediate mitigation options: 1) reduce batch_window_ms for streaming to 2ms, 2) cap max_batch_size to 64, 3) route critical customers to dedicated-pool fallback.
priya: I'll coordinate customer comms once we know affected set.
kai: can we flip the feature flag for cont-batch for streaming endpoints? there's an admin API.
sam: issuing flag change now:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/flags" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"flag":"cont_batch.streaming_enabled","value":false}'
```
sam: flag flip returned 200. starting rollout to us-west, then eu.
maya: routing critical customers off the cont-batch pool -> running redwoodctl command:
```
redwoodctl route update --target-pool streaming-critical-pool --match 'path:/v1/streaming'
```
ops-bot: Routing job queued (job id rdt-7890). ETA ~ 45s.
luis: observing telemetry: p99 in us-west reduced from 16s -> 3.2s within 60s of flag flip. KV miss rate trending down.
priya: affected customers: tenant_32 and tenant_98 elevated errors/timeouts; CS already notified for tenant_32, preparing banner for tenant_98.
maya: capturing evidence for postmortem: attached error logs, sample request ids: rqd-12a, rqd-77b.
sam: quick root cause hypothesis: mixed sequence lengths cause packer to wait for large seqs, small seqs get batched with large ones -> heavy compute + KV churn -> tail amplification. Also scheduler fairness weighting lets large sequences dominate.
luis: pushing hotfix: cap-per-tenant-batch=64 + fairness tweak weight_small=2 weight_large=1. PR: https://git.redwood/eng/runtime/pulls/4523
kai: deploying hotfix to canary (1 node):
```bash
k8s apply -f canary-contbatch-hotfix.yaml --namespace runtime-canary
```
ops-bot: Canary rollout succeeded. No new errors in 5m.
maya: rolling to 30% now.
luis: full rollout complete at 09:50 UTC. p99 stabilized ~1.1s. p95 ~ 280ms.
priya: CS banner posted. customers notified. minimal data exposure, no requests dropped, only latency.
maya: mitigation done. creating incident ticket INC-2026-309. assigning follow-ups: add perf tests for mixed sequences, add per-tenant caps, improve monitoring for pack amplification.
diego: I'm next oncall at 10:00 UTC, taking handoff. leaving notes: see runbook -> /runbooks/cont-batch-tail; remaining work: backfill test coverage + infra alert to trigger at p99>2s for >5m.
maya: thanks all, handoff to diego. closing live mitigation thread. :white_check_mark:
